**Implementation note:** V13 scores whether each grid trigger's target is reachable and sizes it: meta-labelling the grid's own triggers (catalog ML2).

## Description

Trains a secondary model to decide whether to take or size a trade generated by a primary strategy, rather than predicting direction from scratch.

## Where it may fit

When a primary signal has some directional skill but many low-quality entries; performance depends on truly out-of-sample filtering.

## Vehicles

Quant equity, futures, FX and multi-strategy systematic funds.

## Required data

Primary signal/direction, features known at decision time, event outcome labels, costs and strictly chronological folds.

## Caveats

The meta-model can overfit primary-signal outcomes; purge overlapping labels and embargo near fold boundaries.
